entities.label: mp_Representation
entities.description:
Definition: A Representation is any publishable/argumentative entity in the Micropublications model (e.g., Claim, Statement, Data, Method, Attribution, References).
Context: Use this class only when typing elements that participate in evidence relations (support/challenge) or composition within a Micropublication.
Examples:
- Positive: 'Statement S2 supports Claim C1.' -> both S2 and C1 are mp:Representation.
- Positive: 'Dataset S1 supports Claim C3.' -> both S1 and C3 are mp:Representation.
- Negative: 'General background text' (no argumentative role) -> skip.

entities.label: mp_Micropublication
entities.description:
Definition: A Micropublication is a structured evidence graph containing a central Claim/Statement and supporting elements (DataSet, Method, Attribution, References).
Context: Extract when the text presents an explicit scientific assertion plus its evidence components. Link the MPU to its Claim/Statement and to supporting Data/Method/Attribution/References.
Examples:
- Positive: 'The study claims cadmium exceeds limits, supported by Dataset S1 (ICP-MS) and Method M1 (digestion), attributed to Dr. Li.'
- Positive: 'Claim: Nitrate levels are rising; supported by monitoring data and sampling protocol; attributed to the Environmental Science Lab.'
- Negative: 'Cadmium is discussed' (no structured evidence) -> skip.

entities.label: mp_Statement
entities.description:
Definition: A Statement is an assertion with a truth value (true/false), typically supported by evidence.
Context: Extract when the text presents a complete proposition (claim, observation, factual assertion). Model as a subclass of mp:Sentence if available in your schema.
Examples:
- Positive: 'Cadmium levels exceeded 0.2 mg/kg.' -> mp:Statement
- Positive: 'Arsenic contamination is above safety limits.' -> mp:Statement
- Negative: 'Heavy metals are discussed.' (no evaluable proposition) -> skip.

entities.label: mp_Claim
entities.description:
Definition: A Claim is the central assertion argued by a Micropublication.
Context: Extract when the text explicitly advances a principal scientific assertion to be supported or challenged by evidence.
Examples:
- Positive: 'We conclude cadmium exceeds the permissible limit.' -> mp:Claim
- Negative: 'We measured cadmium.' (methodological fact, not a central assertion) -> consider mp:Statement instead.

entities.label: mp_Attribution
entities.description:
Definition: Attribution specifies the agents responsible for creating, asserting, or being accountable for a Representation.
Context: Extract when authorship/responsibility/source agency is explicitly assigned (persons, institutions, projects). Avoid inference without explicit statements.
Examples:
- Positive: 'This claim was asserted by Dr. Smith.' -> mp:Attribution linked to the claim and agent
- Positive: 'Data provided by the EPA.' -> mp:Attribution linked to the dataset and EPA
- Negative: 'Researchers often believe...' (no specific agent) -> skip.

entities.label: mp_References
entities.description:
Definition: References encodes bibliographic citations or source links tied to a Representation and may support or contextualize it.
Context: Extract when explicit citations (e.g., 'Smith 2020', DOI/URL, numbered references) are tied to a specific Representation.
Examples:
- Positive: 'According to Smith (2020), ...' -> mp:References linked to the cited work and to the Statement/Claim
- Positive: 'Dataset S1 from DOI:10.1234/abcd was used.' -> mp:References linked to the DataSet
- Negative: 'Previous studies have shown...' (no specific source) -> skip.

entities.label: whu_DataSet
entities.description:
Definition: A structured dataset used or generated in scientific activities, emphasizing data provenance, semantic targets, and hierarchical organization.
Context: Use this class only when the text explicitly indicates an instance of this concept. Avoid speculative inference; rely on explicit mentions, definitions, or unambiguous descriptions.
 It is modeled as a subclass of <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_IAO_0000100>, mp:Data, dcat:Dataset, prov:Entity. 
Notes: 
1. if whu:DataSet has numerical value, then it should be a whu:ScalarMeasurementDatum, and link to whu:DataSet. 
2. it's best that every whu:Dataset whu:supports mp:Claim
Examples:
- Positive: "The sample is a DataSet collected during the field campaign." -> create node of type whu:DataSet.
- Negative: "The study mentions DataSet as a background topic" (no instance stated) -> skip.

entities.label: whu_ScalarMeasurementDatum
entities.description:
Definition: A scalar numerical measurement datum with one numeric value, an optional unit (string label), and an optional comparator (e.g., '<', '<=', 'between').
Context: Use whu:ScalarMeasurementDatum when the text provides an explicit numeric measurement (possibly with unit and comparator). Ideal for values like '0.2 mg/kg', 'Hg < 0.2 mg/kg', or ranges '12–15 mg/kg'.
Examples:
- Positive: 'Cadmium concentration was 0.15 mg/kg.' -> value=0.15, unit='mg/kg'
- Positive: 'Hg < 0.2 mg/kg.' -> value=0.2, unit='mg/kg', comparator='<'
- Positive: 'Temperature 25 °C.' -> value=25, unit='°C'
- Negative: 'High cadmium level' (no explicit number) -> skip.

properties.name: iao_hasMeasurementValue
properties.description:
Definition: The datum must have a single numeric value.
Context: Extract only when an explicit number is given (integer/decimal, possibly in scientific notation).
Examples:
- Positive: '0.15 mg/kg' -> value = 0.15
- Negative: 'high cadmium level' (no number) -> skip.

properties.name: iao_hasMeasurementUnit
properties.description:
Definition: The datum may have a measurement unit label.
Context: Extract the unit when it is explicitly present next to the value.
Examples:
- Positive: '0.15 mg/kg' -> unit = 'mg/kg'
- Negative: '0.15' (no unit stated) -> leave unit empty.

properties.name: whu_hascomparator
properties.description:
Definition: The datum may include a comparator indicating relation to the value (e.g., '<', '<=', 'between').
Context: Extract only when an explicit comparator appears with the value (or a range is stated).
Examples:
- Positive: 'Hg < 0.2 mg/kg' -> comparator = '<'
- Positive: '12–15 mg/kg' -> comparator = 'between'
- Negative: 'Hg levels were measured' -> skip comparator.

entities.label: whu_EnvironmentFeature
entities.description:
Define: An environmental or geographic context (e.g., soil, river, urban air, farmland, site, province/city) that can carry coordinates and optional demographics.

Context: Create a node of type whu:EnvironmentFeature when the text names a sampling location or environmental setting used to derive specimens or frame experiments. If coordinates appear, map them to geo:lat, geo:long, geo:alt; if population appears, map to gn:population.

Examples:

“Samples were taken from paddy fields in Nanjing (32.1°N, 118.8°E, 20 m).” → EnvironmentFeature with geo:lat=32.1, geo:long=118.8, geo:alt=20.

“Urban air in Shanghai; population 24M.” → EnvironmentFeature with gn:population=24000000.

properties.name: geo_lat
properties.description:
Define: Latitude in decimal degrees.

Context: Extract numeric latitude when an EnvironmentFeature or place has coordinates; ignore DMS unless a decimal value is stated or can be read as a simple float.

Examples: “(32.10 N, 118.80 E)” → geo:lat=32.10

properties.name: geo_long
properties.description:
Define: Longitude in decimal degrees.

Context: Extract numeric longitude tied to an EnvironmentFeature.

Examples: “(32.10 N, 118.80 E)” → geo:long=118.80

properties.name: geo_alt
properties.description:
Define: Altitude/elevation in meters above sea level.

Context: Extract when explicitly given with a numeric value near a location.

Examples: “elevation 20 m” → geo:alt=20

properties.name: gn_population
properties.description:
Define: Population count of the geographic area.

Context: Map to integer; normalize from “24 million” → 24000000 when unambiguous.

Examples: “population ~1.2 million” → gn:population=1200000

entities.label: whu_Specimen
entities.description:
Define: Physical biological/environmental sample collected from an EnvironmentFeature, used in downstream plans/experiments.

Context: Create whu:Specimen when the text names collected materials (e.g., “rice grains”, “surface soil”, “river water”). Link with prov:wasDerivedFrom → EnvironmentFeature; p-plan:isOutputVarOf ← SpecimenCollection; p-plan:isInputVarOf → SpecimenPreprocessing. If measurements of count/mass/volume appear, attach via iao:is_about → whu:ScalarMeasurementDatum.

Examples: “We collected 30 rice grain samples from supermarkets in Nanjing.” → Specimen (+ prov:wasDerivedFrom to city feature; iao:is_about count=30).

entities.label: whu_ProcessedSpecimen
entities.description:
Define: A specimen after preprocessing (e.g., drying, sieving, digestion) used as input to biochemical experiments.

Context: Create when the text describes an output of SpecimenPreprocessing. Connect: prov:wasDerivedFrom → Specimen; p-plan:isOutputVarOf ← SpecimenPreprocessing; p-plan:isInputVarOf → Bio_chemical_Experiment; numeric quantity via iao:is_about.

Examples: “Dried and acid-digested rice flour was used for ICP‑MS.” → ProcessedSpecimen with edges above.

entities.label: whu_SpecimenCollection
entities.description:
Define: A sampling plan describing how specimens are collected (where/when/design/tools).

Context: Create SpecimenCollection when sampling methodology is stated; link steps via prov:wasAssociatedWith → BioChemicalActivityStep; output via p-plan:isOutputVarOf on Specimen.

Examples: “We randomly collected 60 white‑rice samples from 10 districts during 2022–2023.” → SpecimenCollection producing Specimen.

entities.label: whu_SpecimenPreprocessing
entities.description: Describe how specimens were preprocessed before experimentation (e.g., cooling, freezing, filtering).

entities.label: whu_Bio_chemical_Experiment
entities.description:
Define: Experiment using material specimens to measure targets (e.g., ICP‑MS metals, HPLC compounds).

Context: Create when analytical measurement on material is described. Link steps via prov:wasAssociatedWith → BioChemicalActivityStep; goals via whu:hasGoal; precedes via p-plan:isPrecededBy ← SpecimenPreprocessing.

Examples: “Elemental concentrations were quantified by ICP‑MS following EPA 6020B.” → Bio_chemical_Experiment.

entities.label: whu_Computational_Experiment
entities.description:
Define: Data‑only analysis (statistics/modeling/transforms) using software to produce derived datasets or results.

Context: Create when methods like t‑test/ANOVA/PCA/regression/ML are reported. Link prov:wasAssociatedWith → ComputationalActivityStep; prov:used → Software; whu:hasGoal → Goal.

Examples: “We ran PCA in R 4.2.2; t‑tests assessed group differences (p<0.05).” → Computational_Experiment.

entities.label: whu_BioChemicalActivityStep
entities.description:
Define: Atomic biochemical procedure that declares a whu:Method, consumes ProcessedSpecimen/Reagent/Device, and generates ProcessedSpecimen and/or DataSet.

Context: Create per step (e.g., “acid digestion”, “instrument run”). Link p-plan:isStepOfPlan → Bio_chemical_Experiment; prov:used (Device/Reagent/ProcessedSpecimen); prov:generated (DataSet/ProcessedSpecimen); optional p-plan:correspondsToStep; whu:hasExecutionEnvironment.

Examples: “Microwave digestion with HNO₃ (65%) using MARS 6; run ICP‑MS.” → two steps: digestion and measurement.

entities.label: whu_ComputationalActivityStep
entities.description:
Define: Atomic computational operation that declares a whu:Method, uses Software and input DataSet, and generates a new DataSet or result.

Context: Create per transform/test/modeling step. Link p-plan:isStepOfPlan → Computational_Experiment; prov:used (Software, DataSet); prov:generated (DataSet).

Examples: “Log‑transform concentrations; run one‑way ANOVA; compute Pearson r.” → separate ComputationalActivitySteps.

entities.label: whu_Software
entities.description:
Define: Named software used in analysis/simulation.

Context: Create Software with whu:brand (name) and schema:softwareVersion when present; connect via prov:used from ComputationalActivityStep/Experiment.

Examples: “R (4.2.2)”, “SPSS 26”, “MATLAB R2021b”.

properties.name: whu_brand
properties.description: Extract the name of the software.

properties.name: schema_softwareVersion
properties.description: Extract the version number of the software.

entities.label: whu_Device
entities.description:
Define: Scientific instrument used in biochemical steps.

Context: Create Device and fill schema:hasBrand (brand/name), schema:hasModel, schema:hasSerialNumber if stated; connect via prov:used from BioChemicalActivityStep.

Examples: “Agilent 7700 ICP‑MS”, “Thermo Fisher iCAP Q; SN: Q12345”.

properties.name: schema_hasBrand
properties.description: Extract the brand of the device.

properties.name: schema_hasModel
properties.description: Extract the model name or ID of the device.

properties.name: schema_hasSerialNumber
properties.description: Extract the serial number of the device.

entities.label: whu_Goal
entities.description:
Define: Stated scientific objective of an experiment/plan (e.g., “quantify Hg in rice”, “compare urban vs rural PM2.5 metals”).

Context: Create only when explicitly stated; link from experiment via whu:hasGoal.

Examples: “to quantify As, Cd, Pb in white rice” → Goal.

entities.label: whu_Method
entities.description:
Define: Static protocol or named method/standard that steps can declare as used (e.g., “EPA 6020B”, “AOAC 2015.01”, “ISO 17294‑2”).

Context: Create when a protocol is cited; connect via whu:declareUsed from ActivityStep; may mp:supports a DataSet.

Examples: “Digestion followed EPA 3052” → Method.

entities.label: whu_Target_analyte
entities.description:
Define: Chemical entity measured/assessed (e.g., As, Cd, Pb, Hg, Na, K).

Context: Create when analytes are listed as measurement targets; typically link to data via iao:is_about (measurement) and to goals; align to CHEBI when possible.

Examples: “We quantified Cd and Pb by ICP‑MS.” → Target_analyte nodes: Cd, Pb.

entities.label: whu_Reagent
entities.description:
Define: Chemical/biological reagent used in preprocessing or measurement (e.g., HNO₃ 65%, H₂O₂ 30%, standards, reference materials).

Context: Create when concentration/grade/brand are given; connect via prov:used from BioChemicalActivityStep.

Examples: “suprapure HNO₃ (65%) from Merck” → Reagent.
